name: 48209 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48209 (Detroit) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48209 (Detroit) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48209 (Detroit) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
